issues.description: The template defines a function named simulate_one_round(...) while the problem statement and the solution expect simulate_msd_one_round(...). This name/signature mismatch will prevent students from implementing or running the expected API: tests and problem text refer to simulate_msd_one_round but the template provides simulate_one_round, causing confusion and test failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template function simulate_one_round(...) to simulate_msd_one_round(...), matching the problem statement and tests. Alternatively, add a thin wrapper simulate_msd_one_round(...) that delegates to simulate_one_round(...) so the template exposes the expected name while preserving any existing implementation.

issues.description: The problem statement and solution refer to the top-level simulation function as simulate_msd_one_round(...), but the template repository defines this stub with a different name simulate_one_round(...).
